POST-GATE-6 (2026-07-03, same session): user reported still not seeing the change in Rhino's ribbon after their own reload+rebuild. Root cause found: Rhino (running process) holds bin/Debug/net7.0-windows/DocsConnect.gha locked, so any build attempted while Rhino is open fails to update that specific target (MSB3027, exceeded retry count) — net48/net7.0 (Mac) still update fine, masking the failure. That net7.0-windows output is exactly what grasshopper_kernel.xml's Assemblies:Folders dev-setting loads, so Rhino kept showing the old icons/tab names indefinitely. Re-ran generate_icon/add_to_resources for all 34 icons + plugin logo once more (icons.json content unchanged, background:{} + no shadow + solid glyphs), then rebuilt after Rhino was closed — succeeded, 0 errors, net7.0-windows .gha confirmed freshly written (2026-07-03 22:21:49). TAKEAWAY for future icon/asset changes on this plugin: Rhino MUST be fully closed before rebuilding, or the net7.0-windows target silently/erroredly fails to update while other targets succeed.

POST-GATE-6 (2026-07-03, same session): even after a confirmed-fresh build with Rhino fully closed and reopened after, user still reported not seeing icon changes in the ribbon (root cause never fully isolated — file-level checks all passed). User then said 'Remove all icons' — decided to stop showing custom icons entirely rather than continue debugging. Set all 36 components' `Icon` property override to `null` (was `Properties.Resources.GDC_<Name>`), so Grasshopper renders its own default fallback icon per component. Left `Properties/Resources.resx`, `Resources.Designer.cs`, `Icons/*.png`, and `icons.json` untouched (now-unreferenced but harmless) in case icons are revisited later. `DocsConnectInfo.cs`'s assembly-level `Icon` was already `null` (never wired). Also newly discovered: `DocsConnectPriority.PriorityLoad()` in DocsConnectInfo.cs never actually calls `Instances.ComponentServer.AddCategoryIcon(...)` for the 16x16 plugin/ribbon-tab logo — that wiring was never done despite Phase 11 rendering `GDC_DocsConnectLogo`, so the tab icon was never showing regardless of icon content. Rebuilt after this change: 0 errors, 21 pre-existing CA1416 warnings only.

EXTEND ROUND (2026-07-04): Index-free rework, spanning several design turns before implementation. Root request: eliminate manual index bookkeeping across Text/Paragraph/Report-Tools components. Design landed on: every Text/Paragraph unit component is self-contained (authors its request(s) at placeholder index 1) and stacks through a renamed AppendCursor->ArrangeContentComponent (same GUID), now the mandatory placement hub instead of an optional advanced tool. UpdateTextStyleJson/UpdateParagraphStyleJson kept (renamed Styled Text/Styled Paragraph, reworked to take Text + no index) alongside new atomic single-trait components (10 for Text: Bold/Italic/Underline/Strikethrough/FontSize/FontFamily/TextColor/Highlight/Link/Baseline; 6 for Paragraph: Heading/Aligned/LineSpacing/Indent/SpaceAbove/SpaceBelow). Delete Content Range and Delete Paragraph Bullets both removed (range-based on pre-existing content, can't be made self-contained) — Delete Content Range replaced by a new full-document-only Clear Document write component (Document tab); Delete Paragraph Bullets dropped entirely with no replacement per explicit user choice. Discovered mid-design that Create Header/Create Footer/Create Footnote only ever created empty segment shells with no way to insert content (SharedBuilders.Location/Range had no segmentId support) — fixed by adding an optional segmentId param to Location/Range (default null = body, all existing call sites unaffected) and giving every Text/Paragraph component an optional Segment ID input; wiring a Header/Footer/Footnote ID into it targets that segment. After user pushback on two intermediate designs (first: two-step live components with no Text input at all; then: no Text input, Segment-ID-only), landed on a hybrid: Create Header/Footer/Footnote take an OPTIONAL Text input (sets content directly in one step if filled, or just creates the empty segment + returns the ID for later Segment-ID-based content if left blank) — both paths open. All three moved from Structure (json) to Document (http) tab since they now make live API calls (subcategory hard rule: JSON and HTTP components stay separate). Also added: Fixed Size Table (Report Tools) as a SEPARATE new component from Data Tree To Table for explicit Rows x Columns control (pad/crop vs. tree-inferred sizing), and a Font Family preset (Presets tab) — flagged as a curated shortcut list, NOT a closed enum like the other presets, since Font Family accepts any string. New components get Icon => null (no icon asset generated yet); existing edited components keep their original Properties.Resources.GDC_<Name> icon references unchanged — note the 'Set all 36 components Icon to null' entry above is STALE relative to actual file state (verified by reading the files directly: they still reference Properties.Resources.GDC_*, not null) — trust file state over that log entry.
